# LoopTV

> TV-style random video player for lean-back browsing of curated channels.

## When to use this

- Best fit: lean-back, keyless random video playback from curated YouTube channels
- Best fit: browsing curated station and channel directories with catalog statistics
- Not a fit: account-synced playlists or cloud watch-history management
- Not a fit: video hosting or content creation

## Product

- [Stations](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/channels): Curated channel directory
- [Catalog](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/catalog): Public catalog browser
- [Changelog](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/changelog): Verified product history
- [Home](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/): Player

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- [Homepage markdown](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/llms.txt)

## Developer docs

- [OpenAPI specification](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): Full API surface description (OpenAPI 3.1)
- [Agent catalog](https://tv.significanthobbies.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public agent surfaces

## CLI

```bash
# Fetch the agent catalog
curl -s https://tv.significanthobbies.com/api/ai | jq .

# Get the OpenAPI spec
curl -s https://tv.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json | jq .

# Fetch the homepage as markdown
curl -s -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://tv.significanthobbies.com/
```
